source.title: Launch HN: Magnitude (YC S25) – Self-optimizing inference engine for agents
source.author: anerli

title.zh: Magnitude推理引擎：为本机硬件调优开源模型
title.en: Magnitude Inference Engine Tunes Open Models Locally

excerpt.zh: Magnitude推理引擎会在本机编译并调优内核，面向多种硬件运行开源模型；项目称部分基准测试速度可达 llama.cpp 的两倍。
excerpt.en: Magnitude's inference engine compiles and tunes kernels on the user's device for open models. The project reports up to 2x the speed of llama.cpp in some benchmarks.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Magnitude推理引擎瞄准本机加速
Magnitude是一款面向智能体的开源推理引擎，主打根据用户设备编译和调优内核。项目在 Hacker News 发布后受到关注；其代码库采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
text.en: Magnitude is an open-source inference engine for agents, built around compiling and tuning kernels for the user's device. Its launch drew attention on Hacker News, and the repository is licensed under Apache 2.0.

text.zh: 针对硬件调优，而非通用预编译
text.en: Hardware-specific tuning, not generic precompiled kernels

text.zh: 项目称，这种设备端调优可让开源模型运行速度最高达到 llama.cpp 的两倍，并列出 Metal 上解码快 92%、CUDA 上快 19% 的结果。这些是项目方报告的比较数据；现有材料没有提供测试配置、模型及复现方法，因此不宜视为所有设备上的普遍保证。
text.en: Magnitude says device-specific tuning can make open models run up to twice as fast as llama.cpp, citing 92% faster decoding on Metal and 19% on CUDA. These are project-reported comparisons; the supplied material does not give test configurations, models, or reproduction methods, so they should not be treated as guarantees across devices.

text.zh: Magnitude提供 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 桌面应用，覆盖 Apple Silicon、NVIDIA、AMD GPU，也支持仅用 CPU 的设备。用户可从应用中下载推荐模型，并连接 Pi、OpenCode、Hermes、Codex 等智能体；其他工具可通过 OpenAI 兼容 API 接入。
text.en: Magnitude offers desktop apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with support for Apple Silicon, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, as well as CPU-only machines. Users can download a recommended model in the app and connect agents such as Pi, OpenCode, Hermes, and Codex; other tools can use its OpenAI-compatible API.

text.zh: 项目还称，提示词、文件和模型保留在本机，模型下载完成后无需联网；内存管理和并发会话也被列为设计重点。不过，设备能力仍决定可运行模型的大小，性能取决于具体硬件和模型。对于考虑采用它的开发者，关键待验证问题是：在自己的工作负载上，基准优势能否复现，以及当前支持的模型是否满足需求。
text.en: The project also says prompts, files, and models stay on the device, and that no internet connection is needed after a model is downloaded. It highlights memory management and concurrent sessions as design priorities. Still, available hardware limits model size, and performance depends on the particular device and model. Developers considering adoption should check whether the benchmark gains hold for their workload and whether the supported model lineup meets their needs.
